description: Read-only, idempotent campaign readiness status for monitoring and scheduled checks: recipient count, message, channels, cost and every pass/warn/fail check. SENDS NOTHING and NEVER mints an approval token or confirmation phrase, so it cannot launch a campaign. Use review_campaign_readiness only when a human is actively deciding whether to launch.

lead_ids.description: Check a subset of the campaign's leads. Omit for all of them.

name: check_campaign_readiness
title: Check campaign readiness
